title: Evaluation universal property of the linear dual of a common-stage Weil complex
statement: Fix the finite-field datum and coefficient conventions of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], a finite-type $k_0$-scheme $Y_0$, its geometric fibre $Y$, and common-stage $\Omega$-Weil complexes $F,D$. Let $G=Lg_Y^*$ and let $U=\Omega_Y$ with its canonical Weil structure [def-weil-constant-weil-structure]. Use the derived tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and its canonical pullback comparison $t:G(D\otimes F)\simeq GD\otimes GF$ [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison]. Define $D$ to be a linear Weil dual of $F$ if there exists $e:D\otimes F\to U$ such that for every $T\in D^b_c(Y,\Omega)$ the map $\operatorname{Hom}(T,D)\to\operatorname{Hom}(T\otimes F,U)$, $f\mapsto e\circ(f\otimes1_F)$, is bijective, and $e\circ(\theta_D\otimes\theta_F)\circ t=\theta_U\circ G(e)$. The first clause is the universal property of $R\mathcal Hom(F,U)$. For lisse $F$ it is the ordinary linear sheaf dual in degree zero. The second clause specifies the contragredient Weil action (precomposition with $\theta_F^{-1}$), intrinsically by invariance of evaluation. This defines the dual up to its unique evaluation-preserving Weil isomorphism.
